title: Counit transpose and swap of the finite proper external product
statement:
Use the finite coefficient datum $k,A=A_{E,n}$ of [def-pur-conventions]. Let $B,Y,Z$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $a:Y\to B$, $b:Z\to B$ proper morphisms [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Put $C=Y\times_BZ$, with projections $r:C\to Y$, $t:C\to Z$ and $c=ar=bt$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Work in ordinary unbounded constant-$A$ derived categories on the small pro-etale sites, with the pullback, tensor and signed symmetry of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. For arbitrary $H\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, $J\in D(Z_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ write $F=Ra_*H$, $G=Rb_*J$, $E=Lr^*H\otimes_A^LLt^*J$. Let $x=\operatorname{Ex}_{*,a,b,H}:Lb^*F\to Rt_*Lr^*H$ and $\pi_u$ be exactly the ordinary counit-defined exchange and projection maps of [def-exchange-projection]. Define
$$\begin{aligned}
v&=\pi_{t,Lr^*H,J}\circ(x\otimes1_J):Lb^*F\otimes_A^LJ\longrightarrow Rt_*E,\\
w&=Rb_*(\sigma_{J,Lb^*F})\circ\pi_{b,J,F}\circ\sigma_{F,G}:F\otimes_A^LG\longrightarrow Rb_*(Lb^*F\otimes_A^LJ),\\
\Omega_{a,b}(H,J)&=\kappa_{b,t}^{-1}\circ Rb_*(v)\circ w:F\otimes_A^LG\longrightarrow Rc_*E,
\end{aligned}$$
where $\kappa_{b,t}:Rc_*\xrightarrow{\sim}Rb_*Rt_*$ is the canonical finite-level compositor of [lem-weil-derived-direct-image-composition]. Use the canonical pullback tensor and composition comparisons [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso, lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition] and the ordinary derived adjunctions $Lu^*\dashv Ru_*$. Write $\varepsilon_{u,K}:Lu^*Ru_*K\to K$ for their counits. Then the transposes of the displayed maps are
$$\begin{aligned}
\widehat v&=Lr^*\varepsilon_{a,H}\otimes1_{Lt^*J},\\
\widehat w&=1_{Lb^*F}\otimes\varepsilon_{b,J},\\
\widehat\Omega_{a,b}&=Lr^*\varepsilon_{a,H}\otimes Lt^*\varepsilon_{b,J}:Lc^*(F\otimes_A^LG)\longrightarrow E.
\end{aligned}$$
Here $\widehat v$ uses $Lt^*\dashv Rt_*$, $\widehat w$ uses $Lb^*\dashv Rb_*$, and $\widehat\Omega$ uses $Lc^*\dashv Rc_*$; all sources are identified by the specified pullback comparisons. In particular, with the composite hom bijection of [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction], the last transpose equals $\widehat v\circ Lt^*(\widehat w)$ under $Lc^*\cong Lt^*Lb^*$ and the displayed $\kappa_{b,t}$.

Let $C'=Z\times_BY$, $c':C'\to B$ and $\bar s:C\xrightarrow{\sim}C'$ be the swap. Let $S_{a,b}$ be the canonical identification from $Rc'_*(Lr'^*J\otimes_A^LLt'^*H)$ to $Rc_*E$ formed from transport along $\bar s$ and $\sigma_{Lt^*J,Lr^*H}$; the transport uses the same direct-image compositors. Then
$$\Omega_{a,b}(H,J)=S_{a,b}\circ\Omega_{b,a}(J,H)\circ\sigma_{F,G}.$$
There is no boundedness, etale-origin, constructibility, finite Tor-amplitude, compact-support comparison, exceptional adjoint or invertibility assumption on exchange or projection maps.
